Email timeline (S12) · names + addresses blurred
Three lessons from my own emails. One: the process stops until the balance is paid, and my provider chased me six times.
Two: answer everything in writing, and keep a list of what's still outstanding.
Three: treat Google Drive and Gmail as data sources, and get ready to connect them to AI over MCP, instead of sending everything by hand. From time to time things will go wrong.
Learn from them, and iterate.
